ASSESSMENT

Patient is a 72-year-old admitted with community-acquired pneumonia, now on day 3 of hospitalization with concurrent left leg cellulitis. The cellulitis is improving on intravenous cefazolin, with redness receding from the marked border and pain decreased to 3/10. The clinical trajectory supports continued inpatient management with the current antibiotic regimen and planned transition to oral therapy as improvement continues.

PLAN

1. Left leg cellulitis — continue intravenous cefazolin 2 g every 8 hours; plan transition to oral cephalexin if clinical improvement continues.

2. Community-acquired pneumonia — continue current management; monitor clinical response.
